name: cable lying curl
description: A biceps curl lying on your back with a low cable. The position keeps your body steady and your arms isolated.
instructions: Lie on your back on a mat with your head toward a low pulley and take the bar overhead.
Curl the bar toward your forehead or chest.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower with control to full extension.
Keep your elbows pointing upward and your back flat.
